headline: 衛報一週文化評論
context: 這次帶大家看幾則《衛報》的最新評論：警匪影集《Vigil》第三季評價普通，前首相布朗（Gordon Brown）談民粹主義的新書獲得好評，紀錄片《Bel》則回顧一位早逝創作歌手的一生。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Suranne Jones and Rose Leslie are back trying to stop a third world war in the Arctic. There’s plenty of action – but it’s hard to root for heroes whose biggest personality traits are ‘being nice’ and ‘wears good glasses’ Like many a police procedural, Vigil always begins with a cold open. This time round, however, it’s absolutely freezing. We are, as per, thrown headlong into a niche and tangentially Scottish military world where a murder has occurred. The first series took place on board a nuclear submarine (the show is, confusingly, still named after the vessel), while the second split the action between an army airfield in Scotland and the fictional Middle Eastern nation of Wudyan. For its third outing, we find ourselves in the (real) Arctic region of Svalbard. The area is supposedly demilitarised, but four British special forces agents are working undercover at a research centre, and tonight their mission is to extract a Chinese scientist who has made a discovery that could either save or destroy the world. En route, they’re ambushed by Russians who want whatever world-saving-or-destroying stuff she’s got. The scientist escapes – but one of the Brits later turns up dead in a Russian enclave. sources.title: Vigil review – this police thriller is twisty, explosive … and so boring

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Global crises are tightly linked to how we treat each other at the local level, argues this optimistic book In times of crisis, there is one person to whom the left still turns for guidance. More than a decade and a half after leaving government, Gordon Brown has mellowed into the Labour party’s favourite wise elder; one who has never disappointed the faithful by going off to make a ton of money, remaining quietly committed to public service and deeply engaged with the world’s knottier problems. Having successfully led the global response to the financial crash of 2008, and advocated powerfully during the pandemic for global cooperation against the virus, he was never going to simply sit back and shrug as the world spiralled into conflict and chaos under Donald Trump. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Beldina Odenyo alchemised the pain of exile, loss and racism into music as Heir of the Cursed before her death in 2021, as this attentive tribute explores Instead of an artist in a booth, a lone amplifier plays the music of singer-songwriter Beldina Odenyo for a cluster of microphones to pick up during the posthumous recording of her debut album. It is a haunting encapsulation of the absence and presence at the heart of Louise Lockwood’s documentary, which makes a commendably thorough exploration of the mental illness that led to Odenyo killing herself in November 2021, and its roots: exile, loss and racism. Performing under the moniker Heir of the Cursed, a translation of the Tetela name of assassinated Congolese leader Patrice Lumumba , Odenyo was on the verge of bigger recognition at the end of 2021 after a successful performance at Edinburgh’s Usher Hall. But hemmed in by successive Covid lockdowns, the 31-year-old is clearly unwell in a discomfiting backstage interview. Squirming, monosyllabic, she seems to be regressing to the non-verbal state of shock in which she arrived in Dumfriesshire from Kenya as a young child. Continue reading...
sources.title: Bel review – the powerful life force and haunting absence of a traumatised singer-songwriter

thread_text: 這次帶大家看幾則《衛報》最新的文化評論。警匪影集《Vigil》來到第三季，故事場景搬到北極圈的斯瓦爾巴群島，動作場面不少，但評論說主角個性太平淡，很難讓人投入。英國前首相布朗（Gordon Brown）出了一本新書《The Future Starts With Us》，談如何用地方層級的互助對抗民粹主義，評論形容這本書態度樂觀、立場清楚。另外，紀錄片《Bel》回顧創作歌手歐登尤（Beldina Odenyo）的一生，她在流亡、失落與種族歧視的傷痛中寫出音樂，卻在 2021 年不幸過世，紀錄片細膩地記錄了她生前最後的錄音過程。本則整理自衛報多個版面的報導。
threads_text: 這次帶大家看幾則《衛報》最新的文化評論，橫跨影集、書和紀錄片。先看影集：警匪劇《Vigil》第三季把故事搬到北極圈的斯瓦爾巴群島，英國特種部隊在當地祕密行動，劇情動作場面不少，但評論認為主角個性太過平板，很難讓觀眾真心投入。書的部分，英國前首相布朗推出新書《The Future Starts With Us》，主張全球性的危機其實跟我們如何對待身邊的人緊密相關，評論形容這是他對抗民粹主義開出的樂觀處方。紀錄片《Bel》則回顧創作歌手歐登尤的一生，她把流亡、失落與種族歧視的痛苦轉化成音樂創作，卻在 2021 年因病離世，紀錄片細膩捕捉了她生前錄製首張專輯的過程。本則整理自衛報多個版面的報導。
voice_text: 這次帶你看幾則英國的文化評論，有影集、有書、也有紀錄片。警匪影集《Vigil》來到第三季，場景換到北極圈的斯瓦爾巴群島，動作場面不少，但主角個性太平淡，很難讓人投入。英國前首相布朗（Gordon Brown）出了一本談民粹主義的新書，主張全球的危機其實跟我們怎麼對待身邊的人有關，評論形容這本書態度樂觀。紀錄片《Bel》回顧創作歌手歐登尤（Beldina Odenyo）的一生，她把流亡、失落和種族歧視的痛苦寫進了音樂裡，可惜在二零二一年病逝，紀錄片細膩記錄了她生前最後的錄音過程。
